app.title: Oh my AI!
app.subtitle: Local AI in your browser
app.description: 100% local AI chatbot running in your browser via WebAssembly. No data sent to any server.

header.installApp: Install Oh my AI! on your device

chat.runsInBrowser: The model runs entirely in your browser via WebAssembly

help.shortcuts: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a line break

empty.title: Ask your first question.
empty.lede: The model is installed on this device. Nothing you write leaves this browser.

loading.notOnDevice: The selected model is not on this device yet.
loading.downloadWarning: Download may take several minutes and use data. Wi-Fi recommended.
loading.hardwareUnsupported: This device does not seem powerful enough for this model.
loading.hardwareReasonMemory: This model needs ~{required} GB, but the browser only reports {detected} GB of memory.
loading.hardwareReasonGpuBuffer: The GPU can only allocate {buffer} GB per buffer, too little to load a model.
loading.hardwareReasonNoWebgpu: WebGPU is not available in this browser.
loading.hardwareMemoryCaveat: The browser rounds and caps the memory it reports: the figure may be lower than the actual memory.
loading.hardwareReasonBrowserLimit: This model weighs more than {limit} GB: beyond what a browser tab can load, whatever the device's memory.

models.webgpuExperimentalTitle: Runs via Transformers.js (ONNX Runtime Web) on WebGPU, experimental support.

error.title: Error
error.webgpuNotAvailable: ❌ WebGPU not available. Your browser or device does not support WebGPU. Try Chrome/Edge 113+ on desktop or enable WebGPU in browser flags.
error.browserMemory: The browser tab ran out of memory while loading this model. Reload the page to free the memory, then choose a lighter model.

ram.insufficientMessage: Your device has less than {min} GB of RAM. AI models may not work properly or be very slow.
ram.tip: 💡 Tip: Use a lightweight model like Phi-3.5 or Llama-3.2-1B for better performance.
ram.insufficientForInstall: Insufficient RAM for installation (minimum {min} GB required)

settings.title: Settings
settings.hfDescription: A token is required to download some models.
settings.profileDescription: This information is shared with models to personalize responses.
settings.rulesDescription: Instructions that all models must follow. Injected as System Prompt.
settings.rulesPlaceholder: e.g. Always respond in English. Use a professional tone...
settings.generationDescription: Fine-tune how the AI generates responses.
settings.temperatureHelp: Higher = more creative, Lower = more focused
settings.cacheHint: Downloaded models stay in this browser. Model management lets you delete them to reclaim space.

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.description: Connect MCP servers to give the AI external tools.

welcome.title: An AI that runs entirely on your machine.
welcome.lede: The model downloads once, then answers offline. Your conversations stay in this browser: nothing leaves for a server, there is nothing to create or accept.

offline.title: Offline once installed.
offline.body: The model lives in the browser, not on a remote server.

nothingLeaves.title: Nothing leaves the device.
nothingLeaves.body: Neither the messages, nor the files dropped into the knowledge base.

device.title: Your device
device.webgpuOk: WebGPU is active: answers will be fast.
device.webgpuMissing: WebGPU is not active in this browser
device.webgpuConsequence: Without GPU acceleration, a large model takes several minutes per answer. A light model stays comfortable.
device.retention: The model stays in this browser for your next visits. You can delete it at any time from the settings.
